newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures fall again as NYMEX breaks support.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures fall again as NYMEX breaks support.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures extended afternoon losses on Monday as NYMEX crude oil crashed down through key support levels, traders said.
April IPE Brent was trading at $19.24 a barrel at 1905 GMT, 55 cents down on the day, after April NYMEX broke through and held below strong technical support at $21.00 a barrel.
April NYMEX was trading 52 cents a barrel down at $20.87.
"The stops are going here and it does look poor, very poor," one IPE broker said.
"But there is really no volume in London and that is disappointing."
